methods.label: Degree condition and absolute value
methods.explanation: The degree of the highest-degree term \(x^2 y^{|m|}\) is \(2+|m|\). From \(2+|m|=3\), we obtain \(|m|=1\), so \(m=1\) or \(m=-1\).
methods.levelReason: Combines Grade 7 polynomial degree and absolute-value solving with a simple additive equation.
